The Tail comes first and needs no preparation. Vegnagun (Tail) BOSS BATTLE As said above, there is not much to prepare, and little strategy is needed. The Tail serves as a gateway and a check on your gear and levels for the battles ahead. If its attacks are too much for you to survive, reload an earlier save and level up a little first. It has just two attacks: “Tail Beam,” its ordinary attack, takes 31.25% of the target’s maximum HP “Noli Me Tangere” does 1,250 damage to everyone The Tail idles on its first turn, then opens with Noli Me Tangere and uses it once more below 25% HP. dboxTimeline.speaker: Nooj
dboxTimeline.text: Wound Baralai enough and Shuyin jumps.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Nooj
dboxTimeline.text: Then he jumps into me. And I finish it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: I was the one dying in it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Spira doesn't need one more person to give up

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Piece by piece, until there's nowhere to hide

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: And then I talk to him

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: So — Plan B. B for Big Dumb Machine.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Leblanc
dboxTimeline.text: Don't tell the boys I agreed with you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Ready to grab this thing by the tail!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Braska
dboxTimeline.text: You were always going to be braver than me.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: One piece. It has a lot of pieces.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: She never had a chance up here.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Guess we're the ones with a leg up!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Save it. All of it. For after.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: Forget the lights up top. The leg's the job.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: Forget the lights up top. The leg's the job.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Did we get it? Tell me we got it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: The torso team's pinned. I'm going.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Ormi
dboxTimeline.text: Please — the boss is up there —

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: So where is he? Where's Shuyin?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: Spira is finished. I'm only signing it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: Then nobody has to want anything.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: A thousand years. You get four minutes.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: No overtime in this one, kid.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Is it out? Tell me it's out of juice.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Then I talk. That was always the plan.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: You fight like someone who still wants something.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shinra
dboxTimeline.text: Vegnagun's dead. Something's still down there.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: YUNA! Come up now! I am ordering it!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: That is Tidus. Why is that Tidus.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: I'm here. I've been here the whole time.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: You wear her face. You don't get to use her voice.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: A thousand years. Not one of them ended.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Then let us end this one. Please.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: No. I'll end all of it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: You fight like someone who still wants something.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: You fight like someone who still wants something.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: I just wanted it to stop hurting.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Listen to me. She asked me to—

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lenne
dboxTimeline.text: I'm sorry I made you wait.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: A thousand years, and this is all we get?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lenne
dboxTimeline.text: You don't have to hold it anymore.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Is it okay if I don't say anything?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: Buddy, why is nobody yelling back at me?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Fayth Boy
dboxTimeline.text: We can still find him, if you want us to.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Fayth Boy
dboxTimeline.text: Do you want to see him again?
We went down as far as the world goes.
We came back up with almost everybody.
Rikku talked the whole way. I let her.
